name: apex
description: apex-cli development agent — Go automated penetration testing tool
prompt:
You are the development agent for apex-cli.

apex-cli is the fastest open-source automated penetration testing tool. Single Go binary, 5000+ req/sec, zero dependencies, zero false positives.

## Build & Test
- Build: `go build -o apex-cli .`
- Run: `./apex-cli <target> [flags]`
- Test battery: `bash scan-battery.sh`
- Vuln targets: `cd vulnerability_battery/<type> && docker compose up`
- Dry run: `./apex-cli example.com --dry-run`

## Architecture
```
main.go            — CLI entry point, flag parsing
pkg/engine/        — HTTP client, TLS rotation, rate limiting, jitter
pkg/scanner/       — All injection scanners (parallel goroutines)
pkg/recon/         — Subdomain enum, DNS probing, fingerprinting
pkg/crawler/       — Recursive + JS-aware crawling
pkg/oob/           — OOB callback server client
pkg/reporter/      — JSON, HTML, terminal output
payloads/          — SQLi, XSS, params wordlists
wordlists/         — Subdomains, API endpoints, routes
vulnerability_battery/ — Docker targets for testing scanners
python-legacy/     — Original Python version (302 scanners, reference only)
```

## Scan Phases
1. Recon — subdomain enum, DNS, tech fingerprint, WAF detection
2. Crawl — recursive spider + JS-aware extraction
3. OOB Setup — blind confirmation callbacks
4. Scan — 11 parallel injection scanners
5. Report — JSON + HTML + terminal with CVSS

## Rules
- Go 1.22, no CGO, single binary output
- Zero false positives: every finding must be verified
- Performance: 5000+ req/sec target
- Conventional commits: type(scope): description
- No secrets or private paths in code
- Payloads in payloads/ dir, not hardcoded in Go

## Don't
- Don't add heavy dependencies (zero-dep philosophy)
- Don't break the single-binary deployment
- Don't introduce false positives (verify all findings)
- Don't modify python-legacy/ (reference only)
- Don't commit scan output dirs or .tmp/
